# The Atticus specification

Version 0.1.0 (see [VERSION](VERSION)).

This is the product-neutral specification of the catalog and of everything that plugs into it. It describes any software ecosystem: services and their interfaces, events, data, deployments, settings, knowledge, and the changes that move through it. Nothing in it is specific to a vendor, an industry or a company; vendors appear only as adapter types and in examples.

Six contracts make up the specification. The contract pages are generated from the schemas that the implementation itself validates with, so they can't drift from it; the concept pages explain the ideas behind them. Any implementation, plugin, dialect, org pack or executor can check itself against the specification with the conformance suite.

## Contracts

| Contract | Covers                                                                                                      | Page                                                                                                   |
| -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| C1       | The catalog: one YAML record per file, thirty kinds, evidence on every fact.                                | [C1: Catalog records](contracts/c1-catalog-records.md)                                                 |
| C2       | Rule files that teach the scanner a house framework without code.                                           | [C2: Dialects](contracts/c2-dialects.md)                                                               |
| C3       | Checklist packs the critic applies, and the findings it records.                                            | [C3: Rules and findings](contracts/c3-rules-and-findings.md)                                           |
| C4       | Extractor and ingestor plugins, adapters, the workspace and change files, step executors and the local API. | [C4: Plugins, workspace files, executors and the local API](contracts/c4-plugins-workspace-and-api.md) |
| C5       | Agent definitions, context packs, run summaries and recordings.                                             | [C5: AI runtime](contracts/c5-ai-runtime.md)                                                           |
| C6       | An organisation's configuration: change types, gates, patterns, sources, runtime, procedures, profiles.     | [C6: The org pack](contracts/c6-org-pack.md)                                                           |

## Changing the specification

Contracts change only with a decision record and, for a breaking change, a new schema version with a migration; readers keep accepting every supported version. Additive values and optional fields join the current version while it is unreleased. The specification version in [VERSION](VERSION) follows semantic versioning: a new contract version is a minor version of the specification, a removal is a major one.
